name: io.github.Bias2025/stylemycrown-hair-try-on
title: StyleMyCrown Hair Try-On
description: Try braids, locs, twists and wigs on a model or your own photo, with face and skin tone kept.

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Lists StyleMyCrown hairstyles (braids, twists, cornrows, locs, silk press, wigs), each shown on a StyleMyCrown model. Use when the user wants to browse hairstyles or pick one to try on. Free.

query.description: Optional words to match in a style name or category, e.g. "braids", "locs".

tools.name: try_on_style
tools.description: Shows one style on a StyleMyCrown model, or on a photo the user attached. Without a photo it returns the model picture at once. With a photo it changes only the hair and keeps the face; it runs only when consent is true, which needs the user's explicit agreement to the photo being processed (the widget asks for it). Takes about a minute.

photo.description: Optional: a front-facing photo of one person, attached by the user.

consent.description: True only after the user explicitly agreed to their photo being processed for this try-on.
